metadata.description: F-17 — settled-claim contradiction: ARB event asserts Finality=1 with Confidence A (post-settlement ceiling) while its own finality_eta (unix_ts 2026-07-01) postdates its own timestamp (2026-06-16) — the event claims a closed window and simultaneously dates the close in its future. Both operands are event-carried, so the rejection is fully reproducible. Expected: reject with SEM-015.
